title: Shadow Punisher
cast: Luo Yunxi, Fang Yilun, Shen Yujie
summary: A historical mystery drama following detective Li Si and the Divine Constable Bureau as they investigate strange cases and uncover secrets surrounding the fallen kingdom of Liluo.
trailerLabel: Official iQIYI title page and available previews
whyFans: A sequence of unusual cases gradually points to a wider conspiracy.
The detective-team setup allows for deduction, rivalries and shifting alliances.
The costume setting and mystery format give the series a distinctive atmosphere.
review: Shadow Punisher has a strong mystery hook: a detective unit investigates strange cases that point toward a larger threat. The story will be most compelling when each case develops the characters and advances the wider conspiracy. Its historical-fantasy atmosphere and ensemble give it a clear identity among costume dramas.
